prompts.prompt: Production cutout preparation, precise background replacement. Preserve exactly the depicted seed Peony plant: its shape, stage, colors, flowers or buds, matte gouache brushwork, and stem crown. Replace EVERYTHING outside the plant with one absolutely flat uniform fully opaque pure MAGENTA background RGB(255,0,255), hex #FF00FF. This is a CHROMA KEY SOURCE MASTER, so do NOT return transparency and do NOT draw a checkerboard. Fill enclosed gaps between leaves and stems with the same exact flat magenta. Main plant pixels must be fully opaque: preserve coral/red petal shadows, sage/teal leaves and burgundy stems. Clean the outer contour of all yellow/green fringes and stray flecks while retaining softly painted natural edges; there must be no halo or green-screen spill. No additional objects, ground, soil, shadow, text or border. Center the complete plant on a square canvas with at least 12 percent flat magenta margin on every side; keep root crown at horizontal center. Preserve the three intentional petal motes for Full Bloom only. This is a color-key background edit, not a redesign.
